name: vibe-school
description: A free, self-paced course for learning Mistral Vibe on every surface

scripts.zips: mkdir -p public/plugin public/examples && rm -f public/plugin/vibe-school.zip public/examples/starter.zip public/examples/agents-skills-instructions.zip && (cd plugin && zip -qrX ../public/plugin/vibe-school.zip vibe-school -x '*__pycache__*' '*.DS_Store' '*.todo.json' '*.pyc' '*student.json') && (cd starter && zip -qrX ../public/examples/starter.zip vibe-todo -x '*__pycache__*' '*.DS_Store' '*.todo.json' '*.pyc' '*student.json') && (cd src/examples && zip -qrX ../../public/examples/agents-skills-instructions.zip agents-skills-instructions -x '*__pycache__*' '*.DS_Store' '*.todo.json' '*.pyc' '*student.json')
